any_one_fails_the_clip: Wrong/extra character instance, or visibility not matching CARD.cast_instances at the named time.
Unicorn horn / spiral horn on Roshan
Beard or bulky king on Daddy
Text, HUD, captions, watermarks, the word GROK
Extra toilet, sink, tub, waterfall, window, door, eagle, bunny, bird, or cup
Clean restored room on a dirty opening
Whole-room magic-clean when only one fixture is the action
Board, contact sheet, or runtime HUD used as IMAGE_1
People baked into IMAGE_1 who are not the exact cast
Plane with three cabin windows or a rear door
Heraldic / standing Eagle instead of the book bird
Second giant bunny or early rainbow ears
Architecture morph during the camera move
Missing contact: tool floats, no grip, result with no cause
sampled_qc_is_not_acceptance: Watch the whole clip, then first/contact/end and every suspect frame. Use measured fps, frame index and seconds; historical t55 is ambiguous.
regenerate: Complete new clip from the locked still. No morph, crossfade, or composite repair.
